justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/utility/GraalImageCode.java and byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/utility/GraalImageCodeTest.java. ImageCodeContextAction is a protected nested enum with only one constant (INSTANCE) and one method (run()), spanning about 20 lines; it has a single responsibility: probe JVM input arguments for -agentlib:native-image-agent and return AGENT or NONE. There are no extra fields, methods, or mixed concerns, so it does not show insufficient modularization.
